name: stitch-skills
description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
summary: 为 Stitch MCP 服务器设计的 Agent 技能库。每项技能均遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，以兼容 Antigravity、Gemini CLI、Claude Code 及 Cursor 等代码生成型代理
categoryDescription: 开发、调试、评审、测试、架构与工程交付
howToUse: 阅读仓库 README 的安装要求，将 Skill、插件或工具接入对应环境，再按文档触发工作流。
installCommand: npx plugins add google-labs-code/stitch-skills --scope project --target claude-code
